_comment: Solstice paper-diorama style theme. Aligned with docs/ART.md SS1-SS3. The batch tool assembles prompts from these fields rather than from hand-written strings, so the look stays consistent across every generated asset.

medium.zh: 多层剪纸纸雕微缩模型

words: flat matte surface, no specular highlight
four hard light bands, cel shaded
soft ambient occlusion between paper layers
tilt-shift macro photograph of a tabletop model
studio tabletop lighting from one direction
no text, no watermark, no signature
negative: depth of field blur on the subject

pipeline._comment: Installed model triple on this machine (see tools/docs/ENVIRONMENT.md SS3). comfy_batch.py substitutes these into the workflow and uses unet as the default model when --model is omitted.

paper-texture.prompt: full-frame overhead flat scan of handmade paper that fills the entire frame edge to edge, unbleached kraft and warm off-white cardstock, faint horizontal grain, tiny fibre flecks, fully even diffuse light, seamless repeatable surface
words: flat matte surface, no specular highlight
no text, no watermark, no signature
negative: single sheet photographed on a background

ground-texture.prompt: full-frame overhead flat scan of a cut-paper terrain surface that fills the entire frame edge to edge, flat contour ribbons of paper like a topographic map, thin inked level lines, kraft and moss tones, no relief, no cast shadows, fully even diffuse light, seamless repeatable surface
words: flat matte surface, no specular highlight
no text, no watermark, no signature

water-texture.prompt: full-frame overhead flat scan of a single sheet of pale blue translucent washi paper that fills the entire frame edge to edge, gentle long wrinkles, no reflections, fully even diffuse light, seamless repeatable surface
words: flat matte surface, no specular highlight
no text, no watermark, no signature

card-face.prompt: front face of a small handmade card, portrait 3:4, thick deckled paper edge, an empty framed panel in the centre reserved for a symbol, tiny corner ornaments, warm ivory

sizing.card: 2048x2732, artwork only - frame, ornaments and text are drawn by UMG (docs/ART.md SS4)

license.note: All output must be logged in studio/out/manifest.jsonl for the storefront AI-content disclosure.
